name: Freiberufler, 80,000 profit, voluntary GKV
workings: Profit: 90,000 revenue − 10,000 costs = 80,000; a Freiberufler pays no trade tax
Voluntary GKV on all income, up to the 69,750 ceiling: health (14.0% + 2.9%) × 69,750 = 11,787.75; care 4.2% (childless) × 69,750 = 2,929.50; all paid by the freelancer
No sick pay, so no 4% reduction: special expenses 14,717.25 + the €36 lump sum
No DRV contributions (drv: none), so no pension credits
